description: This file defines the ResourceManager class responsible for managing web resources such as scripts, styles, links, and meta tags within the OrchardCore framework. It handles resource registration, dependency expansion, versioning, and rendering of resource tags.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: Manages web resources including scripts, styles, links, and meta tags, with dependency resolution, versioning, and rendering capabilities.

classes.name: ResourceTypeName
classes.description: Immutable struct used as a key for resource dictionaries, combining resource type and name.

methods.name: ResourceManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing resource management options and dependencies.

methods.name: InlineManifest
methods.description: Property returning the dynamic resource manifest, initializing if null.

methods.name: RegisterResource
methods.description: Registers a resource by type and name, returning its settings.

methods.name: RegisterUrl
methods.description: Registers a resource URL, converting relative paths and defining the resource.

methods.name: RegisterHeadScript
methods.description: Registers a script to be included in the head.

methods.name: RegisterFootScript
methods.description: Registers a script to be included in the footer.

methods.name: RegisterStyle
methods.description: Registers a style resource.

methods.name: NotRequired
methods.description: Marks a resource as not required, removing it from required list.

methods.name: FindResource
methods.description: Finds a resource matching the given settings, resolving inline definitions if needed.

methods.name: GetRegisteredLinks
methods.description: Returns all registered link entries.

methods.name: GetRegisteredMetas
methods.description: Returns all registered meta entries.

methods.name: GetRegisteredHeadScripts
methods.description: Returns all registered head scripts.

methods.name: GetRegisteredFootScripts
methods.description: Returns all registered footer scripts.

methods.name: GetRegisteredStyles
methods.description: Returns all registered styles.

methods.name: GetRequiredResources
methods.description: Returns required resources of a specific type, expanding dependencies.

methods.name: ExpandDependencies
methods.description: Expands resource dependencies recursively.

methods.name: RegisterLink
methods.description: Registers a link entry, adjusting URL paths and versions.

methods.name: RegisterMeta
methods.description: Registers a meta tag entry.

methods.name: AppendMeta
methods.description: Appends content to an existing meta tag.

methods.name: RenderMeta
methods.description: Renders all registered meta tags to a writer.

methods.name: RenderHeadLink
methods.description: Renders all registered link tags.

methods.name: RenderStylesheet
methods.description: Renders stylesheet resources and registered styles.

methods.name: RenderHeadScript
methods.description: Renders script resources designated for the head.

methods.name: RenderFootScript
methods.description: Renders script resources designated for the footer.

methods.name: RenderLocalScript
methods.description: Renders local script resources based on settings.

methods.name: RenderLocalStyle
methods.description: Renders local style resources based on settings.
